chunks: And from Abu 'Abd Allah (peace be upon him) he said: By Allah, never has Allah been worshipped with anything better than fulfilling the right of the believer.
Indeed, the believer has more rights than the Ka'bah. And he said: Indeed, the believer is the brother of the believer; his eyes and his guide, so he does not cheat him nor desert him.

And of the right of the Muslim on the Muslim is that he should not eat his fill while his brother is hungry, nor drink his fill while his brother is thirsty, nor dress himself while his brother is naked. How great is the right of the Muslim on his Muslim brother!

And he said: Love for your Muslim brother what you love for yourself, and when you are in need, ask him, and when he asks you, give to him, and do not tire of doing good to him nor should he tire of you, be a support to him for he is a support to you.

When he is absent, safeguard him in his absence, and when he is present, visit him, honor him and respect him, for he is from you and you are from him, and if he is angry with you, do not leave him until you have soothed his resentment.
And if good befalls him, thank Allah (Exalted is His Glory), and if he is afflicted, give to him, bear with him and help him.

key_terms.أَدَاءِ حَقِّ الْمُؤْمِنِ: Fulfilling the rights of the believer

ai.seo_question: What are the specific rights of a Muslim upon another Muslim according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) elevates the fulfillment of a believer's rights to the pinnacle of worship, asserting that the spiritual weight of a believer exceeds even the Ka'bah, thereby framing social ethics as a core devotional act. This tradition, recorded in *Kitab al-Mumin*, elaborates on the comprehensive nature of this bond, requiring believers to be each other's eyes and guides through material provision, emotional solidarity, and active presence in both absence and presence. It underscores the Shia concept of *ta'awun* (mutual assistance) as a divine mandate, where serving the community is synonymous with serving God.
